search control -- renders: search field and search button
account navigation -- renders: donate, create account, and log in
language selector control -- renders: language selection
page-type tabs -- renders: Article and Talk
page view tabs -- renders: Read, View source, and View history
page tools control -- renders: Tools
appearance preferences -- renders: Appearance, text-size options, width options, and theme options
site subtitle -- renders: the operator's fixed encyclopedia subtitle
table-of-contents header -- renders: Contents and the pin or unpin control
table-of-contents controls -- renders: fixed expand, collapse, pin, and unpin controls

page-width preference control -- renders: width labels and radio buttons
theme preference control -- renders: system, day, and night theme labels and radio buttons

sidebar maintenance controls -- renders: View, Talk, and Edit controls
navigation-box controls -- renders: View, Talk, and Edit controls

footer project links -- renders: Wikimedia Foundation and MediaWiki project icons
